grades.quote: For RV32 only, if the D extension is implemented, the FMVP.D.X instruction moves a double-precision number from a pair of integer registers into a floating-point register. Integer registers _rs1_ and _rs2_ supply bits 31:0 and 63:32, respectively; the result is written to floating-point register _rd_ .
